observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructors break down the dance into numbered steps, demonstrating both individually and together. They maintain an encouraging, playful tone throughout the lesson.
safety: Hold your partner strongly with your arms around the lady so you can let her go with no fear

steps_taught.name: The Basic
steps_taught.description: Step side to side with bent knees and loose hips

steps_taught.name: The Side Sit
steps_taught.description: Lady sits on partner's leg while moving side to side

steps_taught.name: The Turn
steps_taught.description: Lady turns while always facing the partner

steps_taught.name: The Dip
steps_taught.description: Partner holds lady securely around the waist and dips her back

what_works: Demonstrating solo then with a partner

quotes.text: So you can understand the movements

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor demonstrates basic footwork and hip movement facing forward

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking down partner dancing by first showing individual solo footwork and upper body posture before combining into partner hold.
